page.overview:
Who is Deltan?

Deltan is a who can be found depressed and hunched over at a table in in . She is a graduate of class.

Presumably intoxicated from drinking, Deltan mutters about "stupid voe" to herself if tries to speak to her. She's attempted to charm some voe with her newfound knowledge, yet all her attempts proved unsuccessful. Deltan complains about a man who told her that he is engaged but claims that she cannot be angry about it. She also complains about a man who only told her that he likes to cook after she took Ashai's Cooking class. Deltan grew her hair out because a man told her he liked long hair, but he then informed her that he liked short hair.

In Tears of the Kingdom, she attends Ashai's "Voe and You" classes. She initially has difficulty speaking to men due to her latest relationship. To help her overcome that difficulty, Link can buy a Ring-Garland from Koko in Kakariko Village and fuse it to one of his weapons or shields. From that point onwards her outlook brightens. In class she mentions her appreciation of snow.
